description: Free photography, from modern stock to museum-grade public domain archives.
description_zh: 免费摄影图片，从现代图库到博物馆级公有领域档案。

entries.name: Unsplash
entries.description: Huge library of free-to-use high-resolution photos.
entries.description_zh: 海量免费高分辨率照片。
entries.notes: Cannot sell unaltered copies or compile a competing stock service.
entries.notes_zh: 不得出售未经修改的副本，或搭建竞争性图库服务。

entries.name: Pexels
entries.description: Free stock photos, very permissive license.
entries.description_zh: 免费图库照片，许可宽松。

entries.name: Pixabay
entries.description: Photos, illustrations and vectors under one simple content license.
entries.description_zh: 统一内容许可下的照片、插画与矢量图。

entries.name: Burst by Shopify
entries.description: Business and ecommerce-oriented free photography.
entries.description_zh: 面向商业与电商场景的免费摄影。

entries.name: StockSnap.io
entries.description: Hundreds of new CC0 photos added weekly, with search.
entries.description_zh: 每周新增数百张 CC0 照片，支持搜索。

entries.name: Gratisography
entries.description: Quirky, whimsical free photos by Ryan McGuire.
entries.description_zh: Ryan McGuire 的古怪趣味免费照片。
entries.notes_zh: 不得作为图库二次分发。

entries.name: Kaboompics
entries.description: Lifestyle and interior photography with matching color palettes.
entries.description_zh: 生活方式与室内摄影，附配色方案。

entries.name: Reshot
entries.description: Free photos, icons and illustrations, no attribution required.
entries.description_zh: 免费照片、图标与插画，无需署名。

entries.name: ISO Republic
entries.description: Free photos and videos under a simple custom license.
entries.description_zh: 采用简单自定义许可的免费照片与视频。

entries.name: FoodiesFeed
entries.description: Thousands of free high-res food photos.
entries.description_zh: 数千张免费高分辨率美食照片。

entries.name: Smithsonian Open Access
entries.description: Millions of CC0 images from Smithsonian museums and archives.
entries.description_zh: 史密森尼博物馆与档案馆的数百万 CC0 图像。

entries.name: The Met Open Access
entries.description: Public domain artworks from the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
entries.description_zh: 大都会艺术博物馆的公有领域藏品图像。

entries.name: Art Institute of Chicago
entries.description: Public domain artworks including famous Impressionist pieces.
entries.description_zh: 公有领域艺术藏品，含印象派名作。

entries.name: Library of Congress: Free to Use
entries.description: Curated public domain photo sets from US history and culture.
entries.description_zh: 美国历史与文化主题的公有领域照片精选集。

entries.name: British Library on Flickr
entries.description: Millions of public domain book illustrations, maps and photos.
entries.description_zh: 数百万张公有领域书籍插画、地图与照片。

entries.name: rawpixel Public Domain
entries.description: Digitized vintage art, posters and book illustrations.
entries.description_zh: 数字化的复古艺术、海报与书籍插画。
entries.notes: Free account has a monthly download limit.
entries.notes_zh: 免费账户每月下载有限额。

entries.name: Old Book Illustrations
entries.description: Public domain scans of illustrations from old books.
entries.description_zh: 古籍插画公有领域扫描件。

entries.name: NYPL Digital Collections
entries.description: New York Public Library archive; filter for public domain items.
entries.description_zh: 纽约公共图书馆档案；可按公有领域筛选。

entries.name: Picjumbo
entries.description: Free photos for personal and commercial use by Viktor Hanacek.
entries.description_zh: Viktor Hanacek 的免费照片，个人与商业用途均可。

entries.name: Negative Space
entries.description: Beautiful CC0 photos with search, new drops every week.
entries.description_zh: 精美的 CC0 照片库，每周更新，支持搜索。

entries.name: Skitterphoto
entries.description: Daily public-domain photos from photographers, all CC0.
entries.description_zh: 摄影师每日发布的 CC0 公共领域照片。

entries.name: Life of Pix
entries.description: Free high-resolution artistic photos from the Leeroy ad agency.
entries.description_zh: 广告工作室 Leeroy 的免费高分辨率艺术照片。
entries.notes_zh: 不得批量二次分发为图库。

entries.name: Public Domain Pictures
entries.description: Free public-domain-style photo library with a premium high-res tier.
entries.description_zh: 免费公共领域风格照片库，另有高级高分辨率档。
entries.notes: Some downloads need a free account; no redistributing as stock.
entries.notes_zh: 部分下载需免费账号；不得作为图库二次分发。

entries.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access
entries.description: The Cleveland Museum of Art's collection images and metadata, released under CC0 with a public API.
entries.description_zh: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆的馆藏图像与元数据，以 CC0 发布并提供公开 API。
entries.notes: High-resolution images and the JSON API are both reachable with no account.
entries.notes_zh: 高分辨率图像与 JSON API 均无需账号即可访问。

entries.name: Rijksmuseum (Amsterdam)
entries.description: The Dutch national gallery's digitised collection; most objects are public domain, some CC-BY.
entries.description_zh: 荷兰国家博物馆的数字化馆藏；多数作品属公有领域，部分为 CC-BY。
entries.notes: Rights are stated per object; the museum also waives its own photographic rights over public-domain works.
entries.notes_zh: 每个作品单独标注权利；博物馆对公有领域作品的翻拍也一并放弃权利。

entries.name: SMK Open (National Gallery of Denmark)
entries.description: Danish national gallery's open-access programme; about two-thirds of the collection is public domain.
entries.description_zh: 丹麦国立美术馆的开放存取项目；约三分之二馆藏属公有领域。
entries.notes: Only the public-domain works are free; SMK waives its own photographic rights, so those images carry no restrictions.
entries.notes_zh: 仅公有领域作品可自由使用；SMK 放弃自身翻拍权利，这些图像不受任何限制。

entries.name: Neurascapes
entries.description: Free stock photos of nature, space and abstract subjects, usable commercially without permission.
entries.description_zh: 自然、太空与抽象题材的免费图库，无需许可即可商用。
entries.notes: Free for commercial use without attribution; you may not resell photos unmodified or compile them into a competing service.
entries.notes_zh: 可免费商用且无需署名；但不得原样转售照片，也不得汇编成竞争性服务。
